english.title: Perform operation to damage site of special scientific interest
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[owner]_
(B)_[occupier]_

of land, namely **(..SPECIFY LAND..), included in a site of special scientific interest, without reasonable excuse,

(C)_[carried out]_
(D)_[caused to be carried out]_
(E)_[permitted to be carried out]_

an operation, namely **(..SPECIFY OPERATION..), which was specified in the notification of that land's status as a site of special scientific interest as being likely to damage the flora, fauna or geological or physiographical features of that land
english.legislation: Contrary to section 28P(1) of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981.

english.notes:
(i) See section 28P(4) for "reasonable excuse".
(ii) As inserted by paragraph 1 of Schedule 9 to the Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000.
(iii) Section 28P(10) of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981 provides that proceedings in England and Wales for an offence under Section 28P shall not, without the consent of the DPP, be taken by a person other than English Nature or the Natural Resources Body for Wales.

(B)_[feddiannwr]_
